Minimum_requirement: Invar36 class or material with CTE mismatch <=5 ppm/K and validated thermal response
Preferred_requirement: Invar36 benchmark if local machining/cost acceptable
Why: combined CTE mismatch, scale-factor and Shupe screening

Minimum_requirement: effective outer thermal time constant >=60 s in acceptance step/ramp test
Preferred_requirement: removable insulation/enclosure with measured tau >=60 s; target >=120 s if no active compensation
Why: v7 Shupe model requires slowing external transient

Minimum_requirement: Pt100/Pt1000 Class A or better, 4-wire preferred
Preferred_requirement: Pt100 Class AA, 4-wire, bonded near inner former
Why: mean temperature / inner boundary for scale and gradient estimate

Minimum_requirement: Pt100/Pt1000 Class A or better, 4-wire preferred
Preferred_requirement: Pt100 Class AA, 4-wire, bonded near outer coil/enclosure
Why: outer boundary for radial gradient / Shupe estimate

Minimum_requirement: 2 channels; sample >=1 Hz; filtered noise target <=0.01 C RMS after ~10 s filtering
Preferred_requirement: precision RTD ADC; resolution/noise <=0.01 C after digital LPF
Why: two-sensor compensation is limited by derivative noise

Minimum_requirement: symmetric / quadrupolar class; model asymmetry proxy <=2%
Preferred_requirement: true quadrupolar winding process with layer/order record
Why: pure Shupe cancels for symmetric fiber pairs

Minimum_requirement: low-stress and symmetric; final material/adhesive after stress calibration
Preferred_requirement: minimal-stress fixation; avoid rigid unknown-CTE potting before test
Why: unmodelled thermo-mechanical stress can exceed pure Shupe

Minimum_requirement: ambient ramps 1 and 5 C/min with simultaneous inner/outer/gyro logging
Preferred_requirement: thermal chamber or controlled heater + reference thermometer
Why: calibrates simplified thermal model before final BOM
